title: 1030 MHz: two SSRs, a fixed interrogator and a TCAS
description: tools/scene_four.json, 10 s looped: SSR-A (II 10, 60 deg), SSR-B (150 deg, a 20 s scan - cut by the loop), a multilateration / fixed interrogator (200 deg) and an ACAS (C82081, 300 deg). Expect talkers 'SSR II 10', 'SSR #n', 'Fixed #n', 'ACAS C82081' at those bearings.
